summary: Two Wyoming boys (12 and 9, from Lander and Pinedale) went missing near a family cabin at Wilderness Ranches ~35 miles northeast of Craig, last seen ~12-12:30 p.m. Sunday; family called the sheriff after their own search failed. Moffat County SO and five Moffat County SAR members (foot and horseback) ran a hasty search Sunday night with a Classic Air Medical helicopter grid search; on Monday a DFPC multi-mission aircraft flew an infrared search and Classic Air flew a second search. Blaine and Luke Tucker (Mountain Air Spray) spotted them at 4:50 p.m. Monday ~3 miles from the cabin; ground teams reunited them with family, no injuries.
location: Wilderness Ranches (~35 mi NE of Craig)
responding_agency: Moffat County Sheriff's Office; Moffat County Search & Rescue; Classic Air Medical; Colorado DFPC Multi-Mission Aircraft
notes: Incident date Sunday 2016-09-04; found Monday 2016-09-05. Article cites a Craig Daily Press original story; MCSO release corrects ages from 13/9 (original story) to 12/9.
